column1: A running total of the number of Spiders managers. Any manager who has two or more separate terms is only counted once.
column2: Number of regular season games managed; may not equal sum of wins and losses due to tie games
column3: Number of regular season wins in games managed
column4: Number of regular season losses in games managed
column5: Winning percentage: number of wins divided by number of games managed
column6: Playoff appearances: number of years this manager has led the franchise to the playoffs
column7: Playoff wins: number of wins this manager has accrued in the playoffs
column8: Playoff losses: number of losses this manager has accrued in the playoffs
column9: League Championships: number of League Championships, or pennants, achieved by the manager
column10: World Series: number of World Series victories achieved by the manager
column11: Elected to the National Baseball Hall of Fame
